title: Schliemann finds Troy
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Schliemann finds Troy, about 19th century at Anatolia, Turkey, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Hinrich Schlimman decided to take that seriously and he found it in Anatolia in modern day Turkey.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells how Heinrich Schliemann, a 19th century German treasure hunter and amateur archaeologist, took the old Greek poet Homer and the historian Herodotus seriously when they wrote about the city of Troy, and found it in Anatolia, in modern Turkey. Michels uses it to make a point: stories people write off as myth can turn out to point at something real.
